Bike shops in Gorham: repairs, parts, rentals

Bike shops in Gorham that do repairs. If something breaks in transit or the night before, start here. Call ahead on event weekends. Mechanics get slammed.

For: Mt. Washington Auto Road Bicycle Hillclimb.

Bike shops in Gorham: repairs, parts, rentals, listed

  1. Crooker Cycle Sports (Berlin)

    240 Glen Ave, Berlin, NH 03570 · (603) 752-3632

    repairparts

    The only bike shop in the Gorham-Berlin area, six miles north of the village; services all makes.

  2. Great Glen Trails Outdoor Center

    1 Mount Washington Auto Road, Gorham, NH 03581 · (603) 466-3988

    rental

    Rentals and a gear shop at the Auto Road base, across from the Glen House. Rental only; race-day mechanical support at the hillclimb is provided by REI Co-op, per the organizer.
